description: Company identity: name, domain, LEI, VAT, CIK or ticker to one verified legal entity — Resolves a company name, web domain, LEI, EU VAT number, SEC CIK or stock ticker to one legal entity using official free registries in a single call: GLEIF (legal name, other names, addresses, jurisdiction, registry id, direct and ultimate parent), the SEC ticker table (CIK, ticker), the EU VIES VAT service, and Companies House officers when the operator has configured a key. Deterministic matchin

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 hint; raises the score of candidates registered in that country.

domain.description: Company web domain; only used to guess a name and to prefer matching candidates. It is never fetched.

include_parents.description: Look up GLEIF direct and ultimate parents.

max_candidates.description: How many ranked candidates to return.

name.description: Company name, with or without legal form.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, matched case-insensitively against the SEC table.

country.description: VIES country code (Greece is EL, Northern Ireland XI).

number.description: VAT number without the country prefix.

name: company-identity
